summary: Master urban mobility and public transport systems with practical tools for route planning, accessibility analysis, and action roadmaps. Enrol now.
lede: Urban mobility planning helps transport planners, public transport managers, analysts and policy staff diagnose service gaps and develop practical improvement plans. The course covers mobility baselines, ridership and accessibility analysis, route and service redesign, service-quality metrics, and KPI-based implementation planning, alongside integrated ticketing, governance and financing options, and first- and last-mile access.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who help shape, run, analyze, or fund urban mobility and public transport systems and need practical tools they can apply immediately.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and the ability to review tables, maps, and simple transport performance summaries. If your organization already uses mobility dashboards or GIS outputs, bring anonymized examples where possible; otherwise, the course will use provided templates and scenario datasets.
